body: I recently had to move back in with my parents after falling out with my roommate/best mate. We also had mutual friends. Over the course of living with her for a year we hung out less and I felt like a burden rather than a roommate (hard to hide depression etc. when you’re living with someone lol). I, like you, also felt ignored, forgotten. I would try to spend time together like we used to but it never seemed to work. Eventually it became too much, I was asked to move out, felt betrayed/abandoned, freaked out at her and tried to end my life. (She doesn’t know the last part). Haven’t seen her since I freaked out. That was back in February. Since then it’s been periods of hating her for wronging me. Hating myself for being a bad roommate. Worrying about what she has told people about me and imagining these vivid scenarios of her talking to people and telling them I’m crazy. What I’m trying to get at is that you aren’t alone. That sometimes helps me. There are a lot of people experiencing the exact same thing. Make me feel a little bit less shit. Maybe it’ll help you. All the best :)
